verdictRationale: Source verification passed on the digest and settled the open question against the family. The bytes match the committed pin exactly and the visible 'AOC-CR-298, Rev. 7/25' agrees with REV-2025-07 — so the provenance chain is intact and the renderer is blameless. But the archived source is not a blank form. 'Courtney Bailey' is in the source's own page content stream at the same rectangle it occupies in the artifact, in Arial-BoldMT 10pt, sitting in the data row beneath a caption set in Arial-ItalicMT 7pt like every other caption on the form. Across all four sources in this shard it is the only non-heading bold text run that is not a form title. No widget in the source carries a value, so this is a filled-in entry that was flattened into an otherwise-blank form before it was archived. Every artifact generated from this source inherits a real person's name, permanently, inside an Administrative Office of the Courts certification block. The second defect stands unchanged: the recorded sourceUrl describes the nonviolent-felony instructions, not this form. Placement itself is correct and the certificate-of-service block is blank.

historicalObjections.originalObjection: protection established by geometry where required, not label alone
historicalObjections.reviewerFinding: Closed against these bytes. Seventeen FINDINGS OF FACT checkboxes, the eligibility checkboxes, NotEligibleReason and the clerk's DepCSCCkBox are all refused as protected_page_region on their headings, and every one of those regions is blank on page 2 of the artifact.

Closed and proven. The CERTIFICATE OF SERVICE block on page 1 — Date Served, Name Of Person With Whom Copy Left, Signature Of Person Serving, Date Service Accepted, Name Of Person Accepting Service, Signature Of Person Accepting Service — is blank in the finalized artifact, and the deterministic filing date 2026-08-12 appears nowhere in the document. EmailCkBox and ServiceAcceptedCkBox are refused as protected_page_region. This is the defect class NE DC-1-15 is still held for, and on this family it does not occur.

Emission is satisfied by field count, but this family's sidecar carries a sourceUrl that does not describe this form — see WCB-B-298-SOURCEURL. A sidecar can be complete and still be wrong, and the field-count check cannot see it. The contract verifier also still regenerates rather than reads a committed sidecar.

findings.severity: substantive; source acquisition defect, now proven
findings.artifact: the pinned official source, and every artifact rendered from it
findings.fieldOrRectangle: the data row of the 'Name Of Records Officer (type or print)' cell in 'REPORT BY ADMINISTRATIVE OFFICE OF THE COURTS'; x=112.3-187.0, y=178.6-192.9
findings.observedResult: The pinned source NC__FORM__AOC-CR-298__...__REV-2025-07__EN.pdf carries the visible personal name 'Courtney Bailey' in its page content stream, in Arial-BoldMT at 10pt. The cell's caption immediately above it is Arial-ItalicMT at 7pt, as every caption on the form is, and the adjacent Date and Signature Of Records Officer cells are empty. None of the source's 107 widgets carries a value, so the name is not a field default: it is an entry that was flattened into the page. It is the only non-heading, non-title bold run in any of the four sources in this shard. The finalized artifact reproduces it exactly, and flattening makes it permanent. It lies in no declared widget rectangle, so no classification, refusal or protected-area check can reach it, and protected-fields-scan.json states its own basis as 'what the renderer wrote' — which is why every existing check reports this family clean. The string appears nowhere else in this repository.
findings.requiredResult: The pinned source for this family is a pristine blank AOC-CR-298 REV-2025-07 carrying no third party's name, and the artifacts are re-rendered from it.
findings.smallestCorrection: Re-acquire AOC-CR-298 REV-2025-07 as a blank form, repin its digest in source-record.json, and re-render this family. Separately, extend the protected-area check to audit what is visible inside a protected region rather than only what the renderer wrote — as written it cannot detect an inherited value, and this defect survived two review waves because of that.
findings.resolvedFrom: WCB-B-298-RECORDS-OFFICER-NAME as originally raised, which could not determine whether the official form prints the name or the archived copy was contaminated. The source pack settled it: the archived copy is contaminated.
findings.provenanceChainIntact: the source digest matches its committed pin exactly, so nothing substituted the file after pinning. The defect is in what was acquired, not in the chain of custody.

findings.severity: substantive provenance defect, provable without the corpus
findings.observedResult: Both records carry sourceUrl 'https://www.nccourts.gov/documents/forms/petition-and-order-of-expunction-under-gs-15a-1455-nonviolent-felonyies-instructions-for-petition-and-order-of-expunction-under-gs-15a-1455-nonviolent-felonyies'. That locator names nonviolent FELONIES and names the INSTRUCTIONS. The artifact it is attached to is AOC-CR-298, whose own printed title is 'PETITION AND ORDER OF EXPUNCTION UNDER G.S. 15A-145.5 (NONVIOLENT MISDEMEANOR(S))', whose footer reads 'AOC-CR-298, Rev. 7/25 (replaced AOC-CR-281 for nonviolent misdemeanor petitions)', and which states on its own face 'For expunction of nonviolent felonies under G.S. 15A-145.5, use form AOC-CR-297.' The URL does not contain the string AOC-CR-298. This is the only family of the four carrying a published locator; the other three correctly carry a master-library: archive locator and digest.
findings.requiredResult: The recorded sourceUrl resolves to AOC-CR-298 itself, or it is null and the archive path and digest stand as the locator.
findings.smallestCorrection: Null the sourceUrl for this family and let the master-library locator stand, as the other three families in this shard already do, or replace it with the AOC-CR-298 form URL after checking it resolves to this form.
findings.whyItMatters: the lane's own stated rule is that a fabricated provenance locator is indistinguishable from a real one until somebody follows it. This one is not fabricated but it is wrong, and it was adopted from the links workbook without being checked against the form's own identity — the same failure with a different origin.

advisories.severity: systemic; no wrong outcome in this family
advisories.observation: regionHeading and effectiveLabel are attributed across columns and across rows, so the protection decision is often made on text that does not belong to the field. The name/street/city block is one column at x≈37 width 278, and its three widgets take three different headings, each a line of the form's title block in the adjacent column. effectiveLabel is a whole caption row rather than a field's own caption: PetitionerState, PetitionerZip, DriversLicenseState, Race and Sex all carry the identical label 'Drivers License No.StateRaceSex', which is why PetitionerZip and NameAtty are refused as 'race' and DOB and CityAtty as 'money'.
advisories.whyItIsNotABlockerHere: every one of these misfires is fail-closed. In this family the values that matter are all bound, all correctly placed, and every protected region is blank — proved geometrically and then looked at, not taken from the classification. The recorded refusal reasons are untrue, which misinforms a reader of the map, but it costs this artifact nothing.
advisories.whyItStillMatters: PROTECT_RULES order means an accidental early match ('money', 'race') pre-empts the correct later rule. On AOC-CR-296 the same mechanism fails in the direction that costs the participant data. Fixing it is a wave-level correction, not a family one.
advisories.smallestCorrection: Constrain region attribution to headings whose horizontal extent overlaps the widget's column, and caption attribution to the widget's own cell rather than the whole row. Re-derive the maps and re-render.

advisories.severity: documented behaviour, recorded for the owner
advisories.observation: When a value cannot fit its rectangle at the minimum font size the renderer refuses it rather than clipping, and records the refusal as unfittable_refused_not_clipped. On AOC-CR-287 the boundary fixture drops FileNumber1 entirely: requiredWidthAtMin 118 against a 73pt rectangle. The canonical fixture fits at 68.9pt in the same 73pt cell, so the margin is thin.
advisories.whyItIsNotABlockerHere: the stated approval criteria forbid clipping, truncation and unreadable fitting. Refusing to draw is none of those, it is fail-safe, and the family's own overflow report names every instance.
advisories.whyItStillMatters: a participant with a long case number gets a blank charge-table cell and no notice that anything was withheld.
advisories.smallestCorrection: surface refused-for-width values to the participant, or allow the cell to wrap.
